description: Curated legacy / high-signal ML math topics. Expand occasionally; weekly digest only gap-ranks uncovered items. Not a trend scraper.

topics.title: Attention scaling factor variance (1/√d_k)
topics.why: Explains why raw QKᵀ saturates softmax at production head dims.
landmark_refs: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need, NeurIPS 2017

topics.title: Softmax Jacobian and backpropagation
topics.why: Full Jacobian diag(p) - ppᵀ is interview- and systems-critical for gradient flow.
landmark_refs: Standard ML calculus; see Goodfellow et al. Deep Learning

topics.title: LayerNorm forward and backward
topics.why: Feature-wise norm is the default transformer stabilizer; backward is subtle.
landmark_refs: Ba, Kiros, Hinton, Layer Normalization, 2016

topics.title: RMSNorm math vs LayerNorm
topics.why: Modern LLMs drop mean-centering; derive cost and gradient differences.
landmark_refs: Zhang & Sennrich, Root Mean Square Layer Normalization, 2019

topics.title: BatchNorm vs LayerNorm (when each is valid)
topics.why: Batch dependence vs token dependence; train/eval mismatch story.
landmark_refs: Ioffe & Szegedy, Batch Normalization, ICML 2015
Ba et al., Layer Normalization, 2016

topics.title: Pre-LN vs Post-LN residual signal propagation
topics.why: Explains training stability of deep transformers.
landmark_refs: Xiong et al., On Layer Normalization in the Transformer Architecture, ICML 2020

topics.title: Residual connections as identity gradient highways
topics.why: ∂L/∂x path through skip connections; depth without vanishing.
landmark_refs: He et al., Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition, CVPR 2016

topics.title: Causal / attention mask structure
topics.why: Additive -inf mask before softmax; autoregressive legality.
landmark_refs: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need, NeurIPS 2017

topics.title: Multi-head attention as partitioned subspaces
topics.why: Why h heads of d_k = d_model/h preserve compute while adding subspaces.
landmark_refs: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need, NeurIPS 2017

topics.title: Scaled dot-product vs additive attention
topics.why: Complexity and compatibility with packing / Flash kernels.
landmark_refs: Bahdanau et al., Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate, 2015
Vaswani et al., 2017

topics.title: Cross-entropy vs KL divergence equivalency
topics.why: H(p,q) = H(p) + D_KL(p||q); training CE equals KL up to constant.
landmark_refs: Cover & Thomas, Elements of Information Theory

topics.title: Focal loss gradients under class imbalance
topics.why: Modulating factor (1-p_t)^γ reshapes easy-example gradients.
landmark_refs: Lin et al., Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection, ICCV 2017

topics.title: Label smoothing as target entropy regularization
topics.why: Soft targets change CE gradient; calibration tradeoffs.
landmark_refs: Szegedy et al., Rethinking the Inception Architecture, CVPR 2016

topics.title: Temperature scaling of logits
topics.why: Softmax(z/T) controls peakiness; distillation and calibration link.
landmark_refs: Hinton et al., Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network, 2015
Guo et al., On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks, ICML 2017

topics.title: NLL, CE, and log-softmax numerically stable form
topics.why: logsumexp trick; why naive CE overflows.
landmark_refs: PyTorch docs / standard numerical analysis

topics.title: InfoNCE / contrastive loss derivation
topics.why: Lower bound on mutual information; CLIP-style training math.
landmark_refs: Oord et al., Representation Learning with Contrastive Predictive Coding, 2018

topics.title: Adam first/second moment and bias correction
topics.why: Bias fix is the non-obvious part of Adam; interview staple.
landmark_refs: Kingma & Ba, Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization, ICLR 2015

topics.title: RMSProp as adaptive second-moment SGD
topics.why: Bridge from AdaGrad to Adam; per-coordinate step sizes.
landmark_refs: Tieleman & Hinton, RMSProp (lecture notes), 2012

topics.title: Weight decay vs L2 regularization (SGD vs Adam)
topics.why: Decoupled decay ≠ L2 under adaptive methods.
landmark_refs: Loshchilov & Hutter, Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization, ICLR 2019

topics.title: AdaGrad accumulator and diminishing steps
topics.why: Historical root of adaptive methods; why it stalls.
landmark_refs: Duchi et al., Adaptive Subgradient Methods, JMLR 2011

topics.title: Learning-rate warmup and inverse-sqrt schedules
topics.why: Transformer training schedules; early instability math.
landmark_refs: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need, NeurIPS 2017

topics.title: Gradient clipping (global norm) effect on update
topics.why: When and how clipping changes the effective step.
landmark_refs: Pascanu et al., On the difficulty of training RNNs, ICML 2013

topics.title: Xavier / Glorot initialization variance
topics.why: Preserve activation variance forward and backward for tanh/sigmoid nets.
landmark_refs: Glorot & Bengio, Understanding the difficulty of training deep feedforward networks, AISTATS 2010

topics.title: He / Kaiming initialization for ReLU
topics.why: Half-rectifier correction to Glorot; modern CNN/LLM defaults.
landmark_refs: He et al., Delving Deep into Rectifiers, ICCV 2015

topics.title: Dropout as Bernoulli expectation at train/eval
topics.why: Inverted dropout scaling; equivalence to geometric ensemble.
landmark_refs: Srivastava et al., Dropout, JMLR 2014

topics.title: GELU / Swish derivative and smoothness
topics.why: Why smooth gates beat ReLU in transformers.
landmark_refs: Hendrycks & Gimpel, Gaussian Error Linear Units, 2016
Ramachandran et al., Searching for Activation Functions, 2017

topics.title: SwiGLU and gated linear unit dynamics
topics.why: Gating + SiLU; parameter vs quality tradeoff in LLaMA-style FFNs.
landmark_refs: Shazeer, GLU Variants Improve Transformer, 2020

topics.title: RoPE multi-dimensional derivation
topics.why: Complex rotation encodes relative position in attention logits.
landmark_refs: Su et al., RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding, 2021

topics.title: Sinusoidal absolute positional encodings
topics.why: Original transformer PE; linear attention of positions via sinusoids.
landmark_refs: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need, NeurIPS 2017

topics.title: ALiBi attention bias
topics.why: Linear distance bias without learned PE; length extrapolation story.
landmark_refs: Press et al., Train Short, Test Long: Attention with Linear Biases, 2021

topics.title: KV-cache memory footprint scaling
topics.why: Bytes ∝ layers × batch × seq × heads × d_k × dtype; inference bottleneck.
landmark_refs: Pope et al., Efficiently Scaling Transformer Inference, 2022

topics.title: GQA / MQA memory–quality tradeoff math
topics.why: Shared KV heads shrink cache; derive FLOPs vs memory.
landmark_refs: Ainslie et al., GQA, 2023
Shazeer, Multi-Query Attention, 2019

topics.title: FlashAttention IO-awareness (high-level identity)
topics.why: Tiling softmax without materializing N²; HBM vs SRAM story.
landmark_refs: Dao et al., FlashAttention, NeurIPS 2022

topics.title: Mixture-of-Experts routing load balance
topics.why: Gate softmax + auxiliary loss; capacity factor math.
landmark_refs: Shazeer et al., Outrageously Large Neural Networks (MoE), ICLR 2017

topics.title: Speculative decoding acceptance probability
topics.why: Draft–verify speedup; when acceptance preserves target distribution.
landmark_refs: Leviathan et al., Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding, ICML 2023

topics.title: Top-k / top-p / temperature sampling identities
topics.why: How truncation changes the induced distribution.
landmark_refs: Holtzman et al., The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration, ICLR 2020

topics.title: Beam search score normalization
topics.why: Length penalty; why raw log-prob prefers short strings.
landmark_refs: Wu et al., Google's NMT System, 2016

topics.title: Embedding matrix as tied input/output (weight tying)
topics.why: Parameter count and inductive bias of tied softmax.
landmark_refs: Press & Wolf, Using the Output Embedding to Improve Language Models, 2017

topics.title: Word2Vec skip-gram with negative sampling
topics.why: Classic contrastive-style objective before modern InfoNCE.
landmark_refs: Mikolov et al., Distributed Representations of Words and Phrases, NeurIPS 2013

topics.title: PCA as eigendecomposition of covariance
topics.why: Baseline linear dimensionality reduction every interview expects.
landmark_refs: Bishop, Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning

topics.title: Bias–variance decomposition of MSE
topics.why: Classic generalization identity.
landmark_refs: Hastie, Tibshirani, Friedman, Elements of Statistical Learning

topics.title: MLE for Gaussian and Bernoulli → MSE / CE
topics.why: Why common losses are maximum likelihood under simple noise models.
landmark_refs: Goodfellow et al., Deep Learning

topics.title: Backprop through a linear layer (matrix calculus)
topics.why: Shape rules for ∂L/∂W, ∂L/∂x; foundation for every module.
landmark_refs: Petersen & Pedersen, The Matrix Cookbook

topics.title: Convolution as Toeplitz / im2col matmul
topics.why: Connects CNN ops to linear algebra and FLOP counts.
landmark_refs: Dumoulin & Visin, A guide to convolution arithmetic for deep learning, 2016

topics.title: Batch matrix multiply and attention FLOP count
topics.why: O(n² d) attention cost; ties theory to hardware budgets.
landmark_refs: Vaswani et al., 2017; Kaplan et al., Scaling Laws, 2020

topics.title: LoRA low-rank update math
topics.why: ΔW = BA; parameter and rank intuition for fine-tuning.
landmark_refs: Hu et al., LoRA, ICLR 2022

topics.title: μP / maximal update parametrization (sketch)
topics.why: How width-scaling changes learning-rate transfer.
landmark_refs: Yang et al., Tensor Programs V: Tuning Large Neural Networks via Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer, 2022

topics.title: DDPM forward/reverse process (Gaussian Markov)
topics.why: Core diffusion math still high portfolio value.
landmark_refs: Ho et al., Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models, NeurIPS 2020

topics.title: Policy gradient / REINFORCE baseline identity
topics.why: Bridge to RLHF-era interview questions without full RL product.
landmark_refs: Williams, Simple Statistical Gradient-Following Algorithms for Connectionist Reinforcement Learning, 1992

topics.title: KL-regularized RL / reward model objective sketch
topics.why: PPO/RLHF-style KL penalty intuition for LLM alignment posts.
landmark_refs: Schulman et al., PPO, 2017
Ouyang et al., InstructGPT, 2022
